---
title: "SPiCT model dashboard"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
    theme: cosmo
    toc: true
    toc-depth: 2
execute:
  warning: false
  message: false
  echo: false
params:
  model_rds: null
  summary_rds: null
  model_name: "bm_jun"
  description: ""
  app_dir: null
---

```{r}
app_dir <- if (is.null(params$app_dir) || !nzchar(params$app_dir)) {
  getwd()
} else {
  normalizePath(params$app_dir, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
}

source(file.path(app_dir, "src", "0_setup.R"))
source(file.path(app_dir, "src/exploration", "additional_spict_funcs.R"))
source(file.path(app_dir, "src", "ices_plots.R"))

res <- readRDS(params$model_rds)
spict_summary <- readRDS(params$summary_rds)

cat("Model:", params$model_name, "\n")
cat("Description:", params$description, "\n")
cat("Convergence:", res$opt$convergence, "\n")
```

# Summary and parameter correlation matrix

```{r}
summary(res)
all(is.finite(res$sd))
cov2cor(res$cov.fixed)
```

# General plots

```{r}
plot(res)
```

## Biomass

```{r}
tryCatch(plotspict.bbmsy(res), error = function(e) NULL)
tryCatch(plotspict.biomass(res), error = function(e) NULL)
```

## Catch and F

```{r}
tryCatch(plotspict.catch(res), error = function(e) NULL)
tryCatch(plotspict.f(res), error = function(e) NULL)
tryCatch(plotspict.ffmsy(res), error = function(e) NULL)
```

## Kobe and Years to Bmsy

```{r}
tryCatch(plotspict.fb(res), error = function(e) NULL)
tryCatch(plotspict.tc(res), error = function(e) NULL)
```

## Production curve and priors

```{r}
tryCatch(plotspict.production(res), error = function(e) NULL)
tryCatch(plotspict.priors(res), error = function(e) NULL)
```

# Catch observed vs fitted

```{r}
ms <- list(res)
attr(ms[[1]], "model_name") <- params$model_name
tryCatch(comp_plot2(ms = ms, variables = c("logCpred")), error = function(e) NULL)
```

# Index observed vs fitted

```{r}
tryCatch(comp_plot2(ms = ms, variables = c("logIpred")), error = function(e) NULL)
```

# OSA residuals

```{r}
tryCatch({
  res_osa <- calc.osa.resid(res)
  plotspict.diagnostic(res_osa)
}, error = function(e) NULL)
```

# Process residuals

```{r}
tryCatch({
  res_proc <- calc.process.resid(res)
  plotspict.diagnostic.process(res_proc)
}, error = function(e) NULL)
```

# SPiCT summary

```{r}
summary_plot(spict_summary)
```

```{r}
head(spict_summary$summary)
```
